title: Buildings

entries.name: War Academy
entries.summary: Late-game Military building (unlocked around kingdom age ~220 days). Studies the application of Truegold Dust on the battlefield to boost soldier power; unlocks T11 troops (Truegold Infantry, Cavalry, Archers). Distinct from the research 'Academy'.

key_features.Truegold Dust: Required material for T11 troops and upgrades

details.notes: War Academy is a Truegold-only building: its levels are TG tiers (TG 1..TG 5), each preceded by four TGn-x fortification steps. TG 1 is the base unlock (2s, no resource cost). Full per-level table below (from kingshotguide.com). Resource fields are integers (null = N/A). research_speed kept as the source string. Each level also raises building Power.

entries.name: Guard Station
entries.summary: Defense building. A 'limited' building capped at level 10. Protects the city from attacks; if its durability hits zero the city is randomly teleported.

details.mechanics: When the city is attacked and defeated it starts burning, draining Guard Station health over time; repeated attacks extend the burn. If durability reaches zero the city is teleported to a random map location. Critical in events like Swordland Showdown and Viking Vengeance. Assign heroes with defender skills to boost city defense. After an attack, repair every 30 minutes via the building's 'City Defense' > 'Repair Guard Station' option (gems cannot instantly fully repair; but if online during an attack, gems can extinguish the fire to stop further loss). Good power-per-cost target for construction power events.
details.notes: upgrade_table below has the minimum Town Center level, upgrade time, resource costs, durability and power per level (costs from user-provided kingshotguide.com table). Level 1 is free/instant. Resource fields are integers (null = N/A).

entries.name: Truegold Crucible
entries.summary: Special building tied to the Truegold system. Unlocks when the kingdom reaches Truegold Level 5. Free to build, built instantly, with no level upgrades; provides Truegold refinement.

key_features.Refinement: Refine resources to obtain 1-5 Truegold per refinement
key_features.Special Building: No upgrades required - functionality unlocked at build

details.notes: Unlocks when your kingdom reaches Truegold Level 5. Free to build and can be built instantly. Has no level upgrades but provides refinement functionality for obtaining Truegold resources (1-5 Truegold per refinement). Also seen in the executor tutorial flow.

details.notes: Holds wounded troops after battle. Each level raises Troop Capacity (max wounded troops held). Full per-level table below (from kingshotguide.com). Resource fields are integers (null = N/A). tc_required is the Town Center level gating that Infirmary level. Levels 30-1..30-4 are the four post-30 fortifications; TG 1..TG 3 are Truegold tiers, each preceded by four TGn-x steps.

entries.name: Truegold & Tempered Truegold building requirements (TG1-TG8)
entries.summary: Truegold-only quantities needed to push key buildings from TG1-TG5, and the Truegold + Tempered Truegold requirements from TG5 to TG8. Age of Truegold begins around day 70; Truegold upgrades start after building level 30. From TG5, Tempered Truegold is an added bottleneck for Town Center and support buildings.

progression: Age of Truegold begins around day 70 on the server timeline.
Truegold upgrades start after building level 30 and run through TG levels.
TG1-TG5 requirements use Truegold plus normal resources.
After TG5, Tempered Truegold becomes an additional bottleneck.
Plan Town Center, Embassy, Command Center, Infirmary, and troop camps together so one weak building does not block the next unlock.
notes: TG1-TG5 rows show Truegold only. Standard resources, speedups, and building prerequisites still apply in game.
Training camps (Barracks, Range, Stable) use the same Truegold pattern.
If short on Tempered Truegold, repeat the same TG band instead of jumping ahead on Town Center alone.

truegold_tg1_to_tg5.unit: Truegold only (per building, per TG level)

reference.note: Category labels follow kingshotguide.com. Level caps and the Truegold window progression (30 -> TG3 -> TG5 -> TG8) are documented in knowledge/max_levels.json.
reference.war_academy_vs_academy: 'War Academy' (Military) and 'Academy' (Research) are two different buildings.
reference.training_bonus_scope: IMPORTANT: the training_capacity and training_speed bonuses from each troop-training building (Barracks / Range / Stable) apply GLOBALLY to ALL troop types, not just the building's own type. The building detail text is misleading because it only lists unlocking higher-tier versions of that building's troop type. Verified in-game (Strat Game Sloth video): upgrading the Barracks 20->21 raised the Range's archer training capacity (460->468). Practical consequence: keep the Stable leveled even when prioritizing infantry/archer, since it also boosts infantry and archer training.
